render.tilesManifestPrelude:
# postmarketos (VMID 103) — *** UEFI (OVMF pflash) + PORTRAIT 720x1440 ***
#   q35, intel-hda; xhci usb-tablet + usb-kbd; AHCI disk. VERBATIM LAUNCHER:
#   golden fixture — boots the qcow2 disk pmos-phosh.qcow2 (NO snapshot=on) +
#   a WRITABLE qcow2 UEFI varstore (OVMF_VARS.qcow2); conditional
#   -loadvm golden (logged-in phosh desktop, PIN auto-typed at bake time).
#   PRE-REQ (this manifest performs it, see the pre-seed step at the bottom):
#   seed the varstore once —
#       qemu-img convert -f raw -O qcow2 \
#         /usr/share/pve-edk2-firmware/OVMF_VARS_4M.fd \
#         /data/vms/streamhost/tiles/postmarketos/OVMF_VARS.qcow2
#   The guest (phosh) drives the 720x1440 portrait mode; the streamhost daemon
#   must be (re)started only AFTER that resolution settles (bring-up-all.sh
#   step 5 handles it).
render.bindingLine: postmarketos:{ osId: 'postmarketos',archetypeId: 'touch-phone',     transport: 'streamhost',  accentColor: '#008b4b', eraLabel: '2017 · postmarketOS' },
